name: loop_zone_wire
description: LP-4d2: lines across a loop zone's edge. From a Blank project: a fullscreen pass in the root (its image is the outside node), a loop over a new body, and a fullscreen pass in that body; count 2. The root image's output is dropped on the body pass's color input inside the zone: one edit makes a loop input (named resource, after the port), its graph.input in the body, and the pass's input reading it. The body pass's output is dropped on the zone's right-edge slot: the body declares it (set_outputs) and the loop hands it on as color. The loop's color is carried back into resource, drawn as an arrow round the bottom of the frame: the engine's second copy then draws into what the first drew. The zone's Show in Frame Plan brings the Frame Plan forward with the loop's copies picked, and three Undos take the three edits back to the document as it was before them.
